items.titleZh: 阿隆索在墨西哥大奖赛感到非常沮丧
items.summaryZh: 阿隆索在墨西哥大奖赛几乎回到维修区入口时被要求停车，他非常沮丧。
items.originalTitle: Alonso was really frustrated here because he was so close to getting back to the pit entry. The team insisted he stopped, and he was gesticulating in ...
items.summaryEn: Alonso was really frustrated here because he was so close to getting back to the pit entry. The team insisted he stopped, and he was gesticulating in the cockpit when he parked up with one corner to go #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Alonso told to stop his car on track by Aston Martin. He's in the final sector and does stop - red flag in Q1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 阿隆索在这里非常沮丧，因为他离回到维修区入口这么近。车队坚持让他停车，当他停车时，他还在驾驶舱里做手势，还有最后一个弯道就结束了。#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛Chris Medland：阿隆索被阿斯顿·马丁车队要求在赛道上停车。他处于最后一圈，并最终停车——Q1出现红旗 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn: Alonso was really frustrated here because he was so close to getting back to the pit entry. The team insisted he stopped, and he was gesticulating in the cockpit when he parked up with one corner to go #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Alonso told to stop his car on track by Aston Martin. He's in the final sector and does stop - red flag in Q1 #F1 #MexicoGP
